$comment: Step 2 of the two-agents test. The reader agent has NO files[] of its own — it only inherits the session catalog via agent_session_id. With attachments_enabled=true (default), the LLM sees load_attachment in its tools and should call it to read the doc registered in step 1. Run with the SAME --agent-session-id used in step 1.

config.system_message: You are a document analyst. When the user asks about a document, use the load_attachment tool to fetch it, then describe its contents based on what you read. If no documents are available, say so explicitly.
config.prompt: ¿Qué dice el documento que se subió antes en esta sesión? Léelo con load_attachment y cuéntame en una línea qué contiene.
